content: Class 8 EV energy models commonly fail on mass/payload estimation (use microtrip optimization), constant aux power (HVAC/BTMS can be 60-80% of aux in cold), smoothed GPS grade data, fixed drag/rolling coefficients, and diesel-calibrated parameters applied to electric drivetrains with different regen behavior. NACFE Run on Less: BEV efficiency varies 50-70% between flat and mountain terrain vs 30% for diesel.
